title: 機械応用プログラミングⅡ
subtitle: Numerical Analysis for Mechanical Engineering II
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire the ability of numerical analysis using programming (C or Python). (2) Acquire the ability of evaluating the results of numerical analysis. (3) Learn algorithms for high-accuracy calculation.
advice: This is a basic course in numerical analysis. We will cover the following topics: 1. Review the basics of programming 2. Floating point and rounding error 3. Linear basic calculations 4. Numerical solution of linear algebraic equations 5. Numerical solution of nonlinear equations 5. Numerical differentiation and integration of functions 6. Numerical solution of differential equations Students are required to have taken "Mechanical Application Programming I" in advance. In addition, sufficient preparation is required before the class, as the course will focus on exercises in the regular class.
books: Python数値計算プログラミング[講談社サイエンティフィク]
requiredKnowledge: Completion of “Numerical Analysis for Mechanical Engineering I.”

activityGoals.body: Be able to create source code, including I/O and simple mathematical calculations.
Be able to solve equations numerically.
Be able to solve linear algebraic equations numerically.
Be able to calculate volume and the center of gravity using numerical integration.
Be able to analyze an equation of simple oscillation numerically.
Be able to develop and use source code that addresses a problem in mechanical engineering.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Able to code in consideration of calculation accuracy (2) Numerically obtain solutions to nonlinear equations (3) Numerically obtain solutions to n-ary linear equations with high accuracy (4) Able to obtain the center of gravity numerically (5) Able to obtain the equation of motion for single oscillation numerically (5) Able to solve numerically the equations of motion for single vibration with high accuracy. (6) To be able to apply numerical analysis to problems in the mechanical field, such as the analysis of motion of rigid bodies
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Able to freely perform four arithmetic operations, including logical expressions (2) Able to obtain solutions to quadratic equations numerically. (3) To be able to obtain solutions to binary linear equations numerically (4) To be able to calculate integrals numerically using trapezoidal formulas (5) To be able to solve first-order differential equations numerically (6) Be able to analyze numerically the motion of free fall

lessons.assignments: Review Python before class. Understand the relationship between the educational goals of the Department of Mechanical Engineering and this course.

lessons.content: Internal representation of floating point and rounding in floating point calculations Error
Solving simultaneous equations using LU decomposition
Numerical solution of ordinary differential equations
Solution of boundary value problems for second-order ordinary differential equations

lessons.assignments: Create a report on an issue assigned in class

lessons.content: Review of final exam Advanced numerical analysis
